adaptations: Only the r0 rejection reason is removed for the 100 authorized dev rooms. All other exclusion reasons remain active.
The archived f32 pins and sliced pose entries provide each room's camera inputs. Missing question-file rooms are excluded.
CPU triangle first-hit ray casting produces 320x240 rasters. Provider OBB extents are tested against labeled vertices and stored as full lengths.
The source generator supplies all questions, options, answers, margins, first-seen evidence, frame-N shares and lr bearings. Selection caps each room at four items per type; a short type may use six.
The dev schema carries archive member references and hashes, a model-trace capture flag, and no training target. Training-style traces are saved only under work for scorer testing.
The checker imports neither generate nor geometry and independently recomputes item evidence.
Each small named NFS authority is read into a local cache once; imported authority code reads the cached bytes.
